question: The Chilika Lake is located to the south of the ___________ delta.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mahanadi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chilika Lake** is a renowned coastal lagoon situated in the eastern state of Odisha, India.
 
• It's known for its unique ecosystem, diverse flora and fauna, and scenic beauty.
 
• The lake is located to the **south of the Mahanadi delta**, making it an integral part of the coastal landscape of Odisha.
 
• It is a haven for a wide range of species, including migratory birds, fish, and aquatic plants
 
• The lake supports a thriving fishing industry, providing livelihoods to many local communities.

• Narmada River:
 
 
• The Narmada River flows through central India, originating in the Vindhya Range and emptying into the Arabian Sea.
 
• It is considered a sacred river in Hinduism, with numerous religious sites along its banks.
 
 
 
• Cauvery River:
 
 
• The Cauvery River flows through southern India, originating in the Western Ghats and emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is a vital source of irrigation for agriculture in the southern states of Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala.
 
 
 
• Godavari River:
 
 
• The Godavari River flows through both central and southern India, originating in the Western Ghats and emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is the second-longest river in India after the Ganges.
